announcements.headline: Result of AGM 2026
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of an Annual General Meeting, which typically involves routine shareholder approvals such as director reappointments and auditor appointments. It signifies standard corporate governance compliance rather than a material change in the company's strategic or financial position.
